test-case.name: id-flwor-expr-030
test-case.description: FLWOR expression with an updating return clause.
test-case.test:
<a/> transform with {
           for tumbling window $w in (1, 2, 3, 4)
             start at $s when true()
             end at $e when $e - $s = 1
           return insert node attribute { concat('w', $s) } { $w } into .
         }

test-case.description: FLWOR expression with an updating return clause.
test-case.test:

           for sliding window $w in (1, 2, 3)
             start at $s when true()
             only end at $e when $e - $s = 1
           return insert node attribute { concat('w', $s) } { $w } into .
         }
